recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨噬細胞內含十多個酵母菌，每個菌體被寬大透明的暈圈（莢膜）包圍、中央菌體呈不規則月牙或變形的紫色小塊，大小不一，符合新型隱球菌（Cryptococcus）。
features: Macrophage with a round nucleus and abundant finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Numerous intracellular yeast forms, each surrounded by a wide clear halo corresponding to the polysaccharide capsule
Yeast bodies are variably sized, often crescentic or shrunken and irregularly stained purple within the halo
Similar encapsulated yeast forms also present extracellularly among clumped red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage containing numerous intracellular yeast forms, each with a centrally or eccentrically placed, variably sized, crescent-shaped purple body surrounded by a thick, clear, non-staining halo; similar organisms are seen extracellularly. Distinct narrow-based budding is not clearly seen in this field. The wide capsular halos and size variability are characteristic, and findings are consistent with disseminated cryptococcosis involving the bone marrow; confirmation with mucicarmine or GMS staining, cryptococcal antigen and culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are smaller (2-4 um), uniform, with a thin artifactual clear halo and no thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Talaromyces divides by fission with a central transverse septum and lacks a wide capsule.
Candida shows budding yeasts with pseudohyphae and no capsular halo.
Leishmania have a nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast without a clear capsular halo.
